paragraphs.text: Hilario Zepeda Montaño participated in Meeting LZC-11-01 on 2011-09-18. Bruma del Cobre was linked to Meeting LZC-11-01 on 2011-09-18. Meeting LZC-11-01 occurred at Lázaro Cárdenas on 2011-09-18. A bar owner in Lázaro Cárdenas with regular contact among port workers reported that Zepeda, the plaza boss known as El Hormiga, hosted a meeting at a restaurant near the port to settle a new courier route for Bruma del Cobre that would move product from the port to the Nogales crossing by road rather than by coastal vessel. The owner stated that the meeting was prompted by losses on the coastal route earlier in the year.

Nicolás Cervera Ulloa participated in Meeting LZC-11-01 on 2011-09-18. Hilario Zepeda Montaño used DEMO-ACCT-00118 on 2011-09-18. Meeting LZC-11-01 transited Lázaro Cárdenas port plaza on 2011-09-18. The owner identified Cervera, the Nogales plaza boss called El Cuatro, as the second participant and stated that Cervera had come south to describe the crossing arrangements at Nogales. The account identifier above was the one Zepeda used to pay for the restaurant and for the drivers' advances. The owner stated that the meeting took place inside the port district the network controls.

Bruma del Cobre controlled Lázaro Cárdenas port plaza from 2010-03-14 until 2012-07-09. Rogelio Anzures Tapia led Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. Hilario Zepeda Montaño was a member of Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2012-07-09. The owner characterized Anzures as the person who had to approve the new route and Zepeda as a founding member who ran the port. The owner added that Cervera and Zepeda disagreed over who would pay the drivers between the port and the crossing and that the question was referred to Anzures. The reporting office assesses the owner as having good access to port gossip but no direct observation of the meeting.
